name: Kling AI
summary: AI video and image generator: text/image to video, motion control, avatars and an agent-driven Canvas studio.
description: Kling AI is a generative studio for video and images: turn text, images and references into clips, pictures or avatars with the Kling 4.0 video and Kling Image 3.0 models (native 4K, audio and lip-sync, multi-shot output). Its tools cover video generation, image generation and editing, motion control, avatars, restyle and sound generation, with effects templates and a Canvas workspace where an agent helps plan scripts and storyboards. Public API and iOS/Android apps extend it.
contains: text/image/reference to video and image generation
Kling 4.0 and Image 3.0 models with native 4K and audio
motion control, AI avatars, image editing, sound generation
Canvas workspace with an agent for scripts and storyboards
effects templates and a creator activity zone
developer API platform and iOS/Android apps
